title: The Sorrows of Zion

questions.question: How does the city sit solitary that was full of what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:1 (ESV): "How lonely sits the city that was full of people!"

questions.question: She weeps bitterly in the night, with tears on her what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:2 (ESV): "She weeps bitterly in the night, with tears on her cheeks;"

questions.question: Judah has gone into exile because of affliction and hard what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:3 (ESV): "Judah has gone into exile because of affliction and hard servitude;"

questions.question: Her foes have become the head; her enemies do what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:5 (ESV): "Her foes have become the head; her enemies prosper,"

questions.question: Jerusalem remembers all the precious things that were hers from days of what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:7 (ESV): "Jerusalem remembers... all the precious things that were hers from days of old."

questions.question: Why have her enemies prospered?
options: Because the LORD has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions
questions.correctAnswer: Because the LORD has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:5 (ESV): "because the LORD has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions;"

questions.question: All her people groan as they search for what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:11 (ESV): "All her people groan as they search for bread;"

questions.question: Is it nothing to you, all you who do what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:12 (ESV): "Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by?"

questions.question: From on high he sent fire; into my bones he made it do what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:13 (ESV): "From on high he sent fire; into my bones he made it descend."

questions.question: The LORD has rejected all my mighty men in the midst of whom?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:15 (ESV): "The LORD has rejected all my mighty men in the midst of me;"

questions.question: I called to my lovers, but they did what to me?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:19 (ESV): "I called to my lovers, but they deceived me;"

questions.question: Who died in the city while they sought food to revive their strength?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:19 (ESV): "my priests and elders perished in the city while they sought food to revive their strength."

questions.question: What is happening in the street and in the house?
options: The sword bereaves; in the house it is like death
People are crying; people are hiding
Soldiers are marching; people are sleeping
Famine is spreading; fire is burning
questions.correctAnswer: The sword bereaves; in the house it is like death
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:20 (ESV): "In the street the sword bereaves; in the house it is like death."

questions.question: Why should all their evil come before God?
options: As you have dealt with me for all my transgressions
questions.correctAnswer: As you have dealt with me for all my transgressions
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:22 (ESV): "Let all their evil come before you, and deal with them as you have dealt with me for all my transgressions;"

questions.question: My heart is wrung within me, because I have been very what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 1:20 (ESV): "my heart is wrung within me, because I have been very rebellious."

key_verse_text: How lonely sits the city that was full of people! How like a widow has she become, she who was great among the nations! She who was a princess among the provinces has become a slave.
